notes.subject: אשת כסילות
notes.rationale: 'Mosadi wa bofoleke' — mosadi wa setho/personification ya bofoleke, go swana le 'the woman Folly' ya JPS/BSB.

notes.subject: כסילות / פתיות
notes.rationale: Mantšu a mabedi a fapana a bofoleke ka temaneng e tee — bofoleke bja go hana kgatlhanong le bobabaletši bja go latela batho; diphapanyetšo tša parallelism di ya Lahla.

notes.subject: המיה
notes.rationale: 'Clamorous' (KJV) kgatlhanong le 'riotous' (JPS); modumo wa go lelela goba go phela bophara bja lerato la sephiri.

translation: Mosadi wa bofoleke o hlala a lelela ka modumo o mokolo, o babadišegaka, gomme ga a tsebe ⟨se⟩.

tokens.gloss: o hlala a lelela ka modumo
